'''Neebuk Garbos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Garbos joined [[the Syndicate]] and worked as a bodyguard for its leader, [[Alina Impeveri]], at the Syndicate's headquarters in the [[Ishkik caverns]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. When a group of [[Tarasin]] discovered that the caverns were being used by the Syndicate, Garbos and [[Bhassi Kloor]], Impeveri's other bodyguard, pursued and killed all but one of the Tarasin.

A short time later, Kloor and Garbos fought against the [[Heroes of Cularin]] in the Ishkik caverns, but were defeated.
